d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam cafe style me super creamy white sauce pasta ghar me kaise banae, cooker me easily 15 minute me uski recipe share kar raha hu aap bhi banana, majedaar banta hai!
Ingredients:
Oil - 1 tbsp
Oregano Mix Seasoning - 1/2 tsp
Chilli flakes - 1/2 tsp
Mix Veggies - 1 cup (Onions Shelled, Capsicum Diagonal Cuts & Frozen Sweet Corn)
Penne Pasta - 1 cup
Water - 1 cup
